assumptions.assumption: Windows kernel sharing reservations must retain the actual requested DELETE grant across Win32 and NT paths.
assumptions.basis: Independent sharing-v2 control in four ABI profiles; compiled candidate1 regression lost its fixture after a rejected sharing open.
